answer: Flooding registration pushes an hostile operator to the back of the delta queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier continues earning. The willow index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1007 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the cipher. That is 23 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
